defs.def: the true situation and the problems that actually exist in life, in contrast to how you would like life to be 现实；实际情况

ex.s: Although these campaigns were widespread, the reality is that the majority of the western cities were completely redesigned around the needs of the motor car.
ex.t: 尽管这些运动广为传播，但现实是，大多数西方城市都是围绕汽车的需求进行了彻底的重新规划。

ex.s: Dreams are the reflections of realities.
ex.t: 梦境是现实的反映。

ex.s: And then, we can shift our inquiry from “Is the universe a computer simulation? ” to “Can we model the universe as a computer simulation? ” Modelling reality is what we do.
ex.t: 然后，我们可以将我们的探究从"宇宙是一个计算机模拟吗？"转移到"我们能否将宇宙建模为一个计算机模拟？"建模现实正是我们所做的事。

ex.s: Now that we are in the information age, we have new concepts such as the computer, information processing, virtual reality, and simulation.
ex.t: 既然我们处于信息时代，我们就有了计算机、信息处理、虚拟现实和模拟等新概念。

ex.s: Models are not the reality, however.
ex.t: 但模型不是现实。

ex.s: turn simulations of the universe into realities up.
ex.t: 把宇宙模拟变成现实。

ex.s: By enabling us to tell reality from imagination.
ex.t: 通过使我们能够分辨现实与想象。

ex.s: leading patients5 consciousness away from reality
ex.t: 引导患者的意识远离现实

ex.s: As it became clearer that fashion was what I wanted to do full time, the reality of my day-to-day work at the insurance company became harder.
ex.t: 随着情况越来越清楚时尚是我想要全职从事的现实中日复一日在保险公司的工作变得越来越难熬。

ex.s: History is a mirror reflecting reality．
ex.t: 历史是一面反映现实的镜子。

ex.s: Then one Christmas I received a surprise gift—a large, beautifully made wooden chest My son Bruce had made my Grandma's Box a reality.
ex.t: 后来有一年圣诞节，我收到一份惊喜礼物——一只大而精美的木箱。我儿子布鲁斯让我的“奶奶的箱子”变成了现实。

ex.s: In reality it has more to do with the way an individual talks to himself.
ex.t: 实际上，它更多与一个人对自己说话的方式有关。

ex.s: But Mann thinks Terrafugia has come closer than anyone to making the flying car a reality.
ex.t: 但曼认为，Terrafugia比任何人都更接近让飞行汽车成为现实。

ex.s: Flying Car Closer to Reality.
ex.t: 飞行汽车离现实更近了。

ex.s: This insight grew from the determined attitude of a six-year-old boy who had the courage and perseverance to make his dream a reality.
ex.t: 这一感悟源于一个六岁男孩坚定的态度，他有勇气和毅力将梦想变为现实。

ex.s: For example, advances in virtual reality and wearable tech, as well as the BTP BETWEEN THE PAGES flexible battery, mean we should soon be seeing further developments.
ex.t: 例如，虚拟现实和可穿戴技术的进步，以及页面之间的BTP柔性电池，意味着我们很快就会看到进一步的发展。

ex.s: Verne described in his stories technology and inventions years before they became realities.
ex.t: 凡尔纳在他的故事中描述了在它们成为现实之前多年的技术和发明。

ex.s: Lin even created an equation to explain this concept: Reality + Dreams + Humour = Wisdom.
ex.t: Lin甚至创造了一个等式来解释这个概念：现实+梦想+幽默=智慧。

ex.t: 现实 + 梦想 + 幽默 = 智慧 1 弄明白这个方程式的含义。

ex.s: While he held the notion that objective reality exists, he said our mind plays a necessary role in structuring and shaping our perceptions.
ex.t: 虽然他持有客观现实存在的观念，但他说我们的心智在构建和塑造我们的感知中扮演着必要的角色。

defs.def: a thing that is actually experienced or seen, in contrast to what people might imagine 事实；实际经历；见到的事物
television/shows, etc. that use real people (not actors) in real situations, presented as entertainment 真人秀节目
